title: Grateful Dead Live at Tivoli Gardens on 1972-04-17
source: This is a clean up of shnid 33802.

ai_review.summary: Stunning soundboard recording with crystal‑clear stereo mix captures a high‑energy April ’72 set highlighted by a smoking China Cat Sunflower → I Know You Rider and a powerhouse Dark Star → Sugar Magnolia → Caution sequence.
ai_review.review: The show is praised as one of the band’s peak performances, delivering tight, rocking renditions of classics like Saturday Night, Ramble On Rose, He's Gone and an outstanding Caution. The soundboard source provides excellent stereo Hi‑Fi fidelity, though a few listeners note occasional brief static. Overall the music and the mix combine for a must‑have listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: All seven reviews give 5‑star ratings, consistently praising both the musical performance and the superb soundboard recording; only minor static is mentioned, so rating remains just below perfect.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Stereo Hi‑Fi mix described as crisp and clear; occasional brief bursts of static reported by a few listeners, likely playback setup rather than source flaw.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: Tight, rocking flow with a strong first set and an especially inspired second‑set sequence; the band hits a peak of energy without the extended space jams of later years.

band_member_comments.Phil: His bass work is highlighted as freed up by Keith's keyboards, allowing Phil to tear loose and drive the groove.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith’s piano (and occasional organ) interplay with Pigpen’s Hammond B3 is repeatedly praised, noting the unique texture of both onstage together.
